name: get-hobby
description: Retrieve a specific hobby by its unique identifier (ID). The ID must be a non-empty string representing a valid hobby identifier. Returns the hobby details including name, description, and timestamps. Returns an error if the hobby is not found or if access is denied. Requires authentication with a valid JWT token.

id.description: Unique identifier of the hobby to retrieve (required, non-empty string)

text.description: JSON string containing hobby data with id, name, description, and timestamps
